title: Add "Developed by Emberstone Studio" footer to Settings
description:
Add a small brand/donation footer to the Settings panel, establishing Meridian as donationware and a gateway to other Emberstone Studio products. This is a deliberately minimal treatment — no product lineup list, no in-extension payment flow, just an identity credit and two outbound links.

Placement:
- Bottom of the Settings panel, immediately above the existing Privacy & Data collapsible/accordion section.
- Update both components/SettingsPanel.js and the mirrored meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js identically (the repo has an automated runtime-mirror-parity test that fails the build if these diverge — see tests/*.test.mjs for the parity check pattern already used for other components).

Content:
- Emberstone Studio logo. Use img/emberstone.svg (root-relative, matches how img/aurora.webp and the img/icon*.png assets are already referenced from components — see components/SettingsPanel.js:119 for the existing reference pattern). Prefer the SVG for crisp rendering at small size; fall back to img/emberstone.png only if there's a concrete rendering problem with the SVG (it's a fixed multi-color mark with drop-shadow filters, not a currentColor/theme-adaptive icon, so it does not need separate light/dark variants).
- Text: "Developed by Emberstone Studio" (or equivalent short credit copy — use judgement on exact wording, keep it brief).
- Two buttons/links, styled consistently with the existing settings action buttons (see the existing "Refresh all thumbnails" button and other .settings-action-btn usage for the established visual language):
  1. "See more from Emberstone Studio" → https://emberstone-studio.com
  2. "Buy us a coffee" → https://ko-fi.com/emberstonestudio
- Both links open in a new tab (do not navigate away from the settings/new-tab context). Use rel="noopener noreferrer" (or the Chrome-extension-appropriate equivalent, e.g. chrome.tabs.create with the same safety properties) consistent with how other outbound links in this codebase are opened — check components/SettingsPanel.js and other components for the established pattern (e.g. the privacy-policy link) and follow it.

Acceptance criteria:
- Footer renders above the Privacy & Data accordion in Settings, in both light and dark themes, without layout shift or scrollbar regressions (this repo recently did dedicated work to eliminate a settings-panel scrollbar — do not reintroduce one).
- Both links are keyboard-accessible (focusable, visible focus state) and have accessible names/roles consistent with the rest of the settings UI's accessibility patterns (see existing aria/role usage in SettingsPanel.js).
- Logo displays crisply at the chosen size; no console errors for a missing/broken asset path.
- No new permissions, no new host permissions, no network requests beyond the user explicitly clicking a link (this must NOT regress the "no telemetry, no backend" claims already made in PRIVACY.md/STORE_LISTING.md — do not add click tracking/analytics).
- Update PRIVACY.md and STORE_LISTING.md with a brief, accurate note that Settings includes two outbound links (Emberstone Studio site and Ko-fi) that only activate on explicit user click, consistent with the existing "no telemetry" and permission-justification language already in those docs. Keep both docs internally consistent (STORE_LISTING.md §6 reconciliation notes should mention this too).
- Add/extend regression tests (follow the existing pattern in tests/settingsPrivacyDisclosure.test.mjs) verifying: the footer renders with the correct link hrefs and target/rel attributes, the logo asset resolves, and placement is above the privacy accordion in the DOM order.
- Run the full suite: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`, `node --check` over runtime JavaScript, manifest parsing, and `git diff --check`. All must pass, including the runtime-mirror-parity test, before considering this done.
- Do not add a full product catalog/lineup — that was explicitly descoped in favor of this simpler credit-footer treatment.

activity.content: ## Summary Added a minimal donationware credit footer � "Developed by Emberstone Studio" � to the bottom of the Settings panel, directly above the Privacy & Data accordion. It shows the Emberstone brand mark, a short credit line, and two outbound links (studio site + Ko-fi), with no product-lineup list and no in-extension payment flow, as scoped. ## Changes **components/SettingsPanel.js** (and identical mirror `meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js`) - New `emberstoneFooter` block appended between `tabsSection` and `privacySection`, so Privacy & Data remains last and the credit sits just above it. - Logo: `` (root-relative, matching `img/aurora.webp`/icon references). Decorative � `alt=""` + `aria-hidden="true"` since the visible credit line already names the studio � with an `onerror` handler that hides a broken-image glyph (same pattern as the provider icons). - Two links as native `` � the same safe outbound pattern as the existing privacy-policy link � styled with `.settings-action-btn`: - "See more from Emberstone Studio" ? https://emberstone-studio.com - "Buy us a coffee" ? https://ko-fi.com/emberstonestudio - Static markup only: no `chrome.*` calls, no click tracking/analytics, no network activity until the user clicks a link. **meridian.css** (and mirror `meridian-extension/meridian.css`) - Added `.settings-emberstone*` styles: centered logo/credit, full-width stacked link buttons reusing `.settings-action-btn`, centered labels, and a visible `:focus-visible` ring for keyboard users. The panel already hides its scrollbar (`scrollbar-width: none`), so no scrollbar regression is introduced. Theme-adaptive via existing `--text-secondary`/`--surface`/`--border`/`--accent` vars (works in light and dark). **img/emberstone.svg + img/emberstone.png** copied into `meridian-extension/img/` so the packaged extension resolves the asset (no console error for a missing path). **PRIVACY.md** � new bullet under "Remaining network behavior" noting the two Settings outbound links are inert until an explicit click, with no background request and no click tracking/analytics. **STORE_LISTING.md** � matching bullet in the �3 paste-ready disclosure block (kept adjacent to the "No telemetry or backend" claim) and a reconciliation note in �6, keeping both docs internally consistent. No new permissions or host permissions were added, so the "no telemetry, no backend" claims are preserved. ## Tests - New `tests/settingsEmberstoneFooter.test.mjs` (follows the `settingsPrivacyDisclosure.test.mjs` extract-and-fake-DOM pattern): verifies the credit text and logo src/alt, both link hrefs + `target="_blank"` + `rel="noopener noreferrer"` + `.settings-action-btn` styling, DOM placement above the privacy accordion, that the logo asset resolves in both the source and packaged trees, and that the footer is mirrored into the packaged component. - Updated the placement assertion in `tests/settingsPrivacyDisclosure.test.mjs` for the new `panel.append(...)` order (Privacy still last). ## Verification - `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`: **130 pass, 1 fail**. The single failure � `asyncLatestWins.test.mjs` "sidebar bookmark and history controls switch the list scope" � is **pre-existing and unrelated**: it extracts blocks from `meridian.js` (untouched here), and I confirmed it fails identically on the clean baseline with all my changes stashed. My new footer tests, the updated privacy test, and the runtime-mirror-parity test (`packagedParity`) all pass. - `node --check` passes on `components/SettingsPanel.js`, the mirror, `meridian.js`, and `background.js`. - Both manifests parse as valid JSON. - `git diff --check`: clean (no whitespace errors). ## Notes - Descoped-as-requested: no product catalog/lineup, no payment flow, no analytics. - The pre-existing `asyncLatestWins` failure is outside this task scope; flagging it rather than modifying unrelated code.
